description: This Java source file defines the ExternalServicesProperties entity class, which models the properties of external services within the application. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON commands, updating properties, and converting to data transfer objects. It is part of the domain layer dealing with external service configurations.

classes.name: ExternalServicesProperties
classes.description: Entity class representing external service properties, with methods for instantiation, update, and data conversion.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ExternalServicesProperties instance from a JSON command and external service reference.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the value of the property based on JSON command input, handling special cases like password masking.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the entity to a data transfer object for external use.
